notToBeConfusedWith.name: Half and half
notToBeConfusedWith.note: A lighter mix of milk and cream at roughly half the fat; it will not build the same head in a long shake.

forms.label: Heavy cream
forms.sourceNote: Cream, fluid, heavy whipping. Public domain. The record's own tablespoon portion, 1.0144 g/ml, is adopted as a true density because cream is poured rather than packed.
